name: T3 Code
tagline: One app to control all your AI coding agents - from your phone, browser, or desktop.
sentence: Gives you a single dashboard to start, steer, and review work from every coding agent you already pay for, including from your phone.

board.say: You juggle separate terminal windows for each AI coding agent and can't check on any of them from your phone.
Open T3 Code and pick an agent (or say 'use Claude for this thread').
A project folder and a task in plain language.
Connects to the agent's own subscription on your machine, runs the task, and shows progress as it happens.
steps: Connects to the agent you chose (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, or others) using your existing subscription
Runs the task in an isolated branch so nothing breaks your main code
Shows inline diffs (line-by-line changes) as work happens, on any screen

board.say: A finished branch with a one-click pull request - title, body, and changelog written for you.

outputs.eg: Review the diff on your phone, tap to open a pull request
Start with Claude, switch to Codex mid-thread if one gets stuck

before: Switch between 3-4 terminal windows to check different agents; can't see progress when away from the desk
Writing a pull request by hand after each agent task
No way to switch models mid-conversation when one gets stuck
after: One screen shows every agent's work; push a pull request from your phone while at lunch
Switch models mid-thread when one gets stuck
Title, body, and changelog generated for each pull request
uses_note: Testimonials are from the product's own website (t3.codes). No independent case studies found.

uses.what: Used T3 Code for daily coding agent work
Used T3 Code as a daily agent orchestrator
uses.result: Called it 'the most sane version of an agent orchestrator that I've used'

steps: Install: run `curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install | sh` (Mac/Linux) or download the [desktop app](https://t3.codes)
Run `t3` to start the local server and web UI
Pick a project folder, choose an agent, and describe your task

footprint.disk: no data found (Electron app; release file sizes not published)
footprint.runs_on: macOS, Windows, Linux (desktop); iOS, Android (mobile); web browser

best_for: Anyone who pays for more than one AI coding agent and wants one screen for all of them
People who want to check on agent work from their phone
Teams that want pull requests generated automatically from agent tasks
skip_if: You only use one coding agent - T3 Code's value is in unifying multiple agents
You want a free AI model included - T3 Code requires your own subscriptions
You prefer working in the terminal and don't need a visual dashboard

alternatives.name: Claude Code
alternatives.line: Anthropic's own coding agent - works standalone in the terminal without a wrapper

alternatives.name: Cursor
alternatives.line: An AI-first code editor with its own built-in agent and model switching

watch: **Expect bugs.** The maintainers warn the app is early stage and bugs should be expected.
**Requires existing subscriptions.** T3 Code does not include any AI model - you bring Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or others.
**Mostly not accepting contributions.** The project is largely single-maintainer in practice.
**1,800 open issues** suggest active development but also many unresolved items.
